test_pl_int_range: test the pl.int_range function generates a sequence of integers from start to end with optional step
test_pl_int_ranges: test the pl.int_ranges function generates lists of integer ranges with vectorized start and end inputs
test_pl_int_range_short_syntax: test the pl.int_range short syntax generates integers from 0 to end when only one argument is provided
test_pl_int_range_dtype_validation: test the pl.int_range function raises errors for invalid dtype, null input, and non-integer conversions
test_pl_int_ranges_broadcasting: test the pl.int_ranges function with column broadcasting and mixed scalar expression inputs
